scope: Gateway audit database-write and local-journal failure logs

behavior.database_write_failure: Logs retain only the bounded exception class; the event continues to the local journal fallback.
behavior.local_journal_failure: Logs retain only the bounded exception class when the event cannot be preserved locally.

coverage: database failure diagnostic text is omitted while local journal fallback succeeds
local journal failure diagnostic text is omitted
both log records contain only their exception class

limitations: No Gateway database, filesystem journal, or live request was accessed.
The local audit journal fallback and fail-closed capacity policy are unchanged.
